text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (June 17, 2024) for 11 Lorraine Gardens.

The Property Standards Committee – Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (June 17, 2024) for 11 Lorraine Gardens, Folder Number 24 164971 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension of time to February 28, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
